raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (business date 2026-01-18) was delivered twice, at 02:00 and again at 05:00. It has 666 rows, about 333 distinct txn_ids each appearing twice, and the sampled copies are identical. silver_transactions does not deduplicate by txn_id, so every 2026-01-18 transaction is counted twice in silver and in all gold tables. The fix keeps only the latest-ingested version of each txn_id before applying the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
